name: ai-token-optimizer
description: Automatically reduces token consumption for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex by injecting optimized instructions, installing compression tools, and configuring MCP servers.

aiTokenOptimizer.enabled.description: Enable or disable the AI Token Optimizer extension.

aiTokenOptimizer.autoApply.description: Automatically generate/update instruction files when a workspace is opened.

aiTokenOptimizer.targetTools.description: Which AI tools to generate instruction files for.

aiTokenOptimizer.profile.description: Active optimization profile. Profiles control which strategies are enabled.
enumDescriptions: All strategies active — maximum token savings
Disables output compression (CAP-2) for full log visibility during debugging
Disables verbosity control (CAP-3) for response fidelity during planning
Disables session clearing (CAP-4) to preserve full context history during reviews
Use custom strategy combination from activeStrategies setting

codeGraph.description: CAP-1: CodeGraph pre-indexing for faster file discovery

outputCompression.description: CAP-2: RTK output compression for CLI/log output

sessionManagement.description: CAP-4: Session management and context hygiene

semanticCache.description: CAP-5: Local semantic cache — serve repeated/similar questions from disk

aiTokenOptimizer.activeStrategies.description: Toggle individual strategies (used when profile is 'custom').

aiTokenOptimizer.verbosityLevel.description: Caveman verbosity reduction level. Light (~20%), Full (~35%), Ultra (~50%).

aiTokenOptimizer.preserveExistingInstruc.description: Preserve existing content in instruction files when updating.

aiTokenOptimizer.autoInstallTools.description: Automatically install CodeGraph, RTK, and Caveman packages on activation.

aiTokenOptimizer.configureMcpOnActivatio.description: Automatically configure MCP servers (Context7, CodeGraph) on activation.

aiTokenOptimizer.codeGraphProjects.description: Specific projects/folders to include in the CodeGraph index. If empty, all workspace folders are indexed.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the project root

enabled.description: Whether this project is actively indexed
